name: Closing line rides a glitching waveform
looks: A closing statement in two lines types on, part of it rendered with a trailing double-exposure glitch ghosting slightly behind the main text. Beneath it, a thin strip of waveform bars pulses with the music, tying the words directly to the sound they describe.
build: Text fades/types on in two weights (plain, italic for the key phrase); the glitch ghost is a second copy of the text layer offset 3-5px and delayed 2-3 frames behind the main layer at 40% opacity. The waveform strip underneath is 40-60 bars driven by a precomputed per-frame amplitude lookup, smoothed with a fast attack / slow release.
sound: The track itself, mixed forward under this line so the waveform's pulse is legible against it.
prompt: Close on a short two-line statement about sound or rhythm, typed on with a faint trailing ghost-glitch behind the key phrase, sitting directly above a thin strip of waveform bars pulsing with the track, so the words and the music visibly belong to each other.
